title: galium tarmense

This plant is known to possess various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of Galium tarmense include iridoid glycosides and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
